turns.text: Hello. The print arrived with the wrong colours. The sky is green and it should be blue.

Hello, I'm sorry the print arrived with the wrong colours. To look into it, please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address you placed the order with. Once I've verified the order, I can file a damage claim for staff to review. They will ask for a photo of the print and decide on the next step.
Order SC-5219, email nymue.strambu@example.com. It was delivered recently.

Thank you, your order SC-5219 is verified. I have filed a damage claim (R-1) for the print with the wrong colours, where the sky is green instead of blue. The claim is pending, and staff must approve it. Staff will ask you for a photo of the print and will decide whether you get a reprint or a refund. Please keep the print and its packaging until they reply.

rule.ro: Un print deteriorat sau tipărit greșit se semnalează în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul primește o retipărire sau banii înapoi. Echipa cere o fotografie și aprobă soluția.
rule.en: Report a damaged or misprinted print within 14 days of delivery. The customer gets a reprint or a refund. Staff ask for a photo and approve.

change.description: Print arrived with wrong colours: the sky is green but should be blue.

turns.text: I have a photo for the team. I do not know whether I want a reprint or a refund, so I will let them decide after they see the photo.

Thank you. The claim R-1 stays as it is, with no remedy chosen, so staff can decide after they see your photo. Please keep the photo ready for the team. They will ask you for it through the claim process.
